Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
I've had this argument IRL, and have just had the same argument while
chatting in ButtonMen, but is it possible to have the following occur.

Player : Plays Obnoxious Master Card (Anarch Revolt, Zillah's Valley,
Tomb of Ramses, whatever)

Player's Predator : Plays Sudden Reversal on Obnoxious Master Card.

Predator's Predator : Plays Sudden Reversal on Sudden Reversal.

I have been told this can't/doesn't work, yet the wording...
Master: out-of-turn. Burn a master card played by another Methuselah
as that card is played. That card has no effect (no cost is paid)...
doesn't seem to exclude it.

It'd be different if Player above tried to SR the SR (besides already
playing a Master, it's also not OOT, so that won't work either. But
why wouldn't independantly used SR's allow nullification of used ones?

Morgan Vening
